Job Title: Business Operations Specialist

Location: Whitefield, Bangalore
Employment Type: Full-time, on-site

Location: Bengaluru, India

Experience: 5–7 Years

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Operations Specialist to support and drive end- to-end sales and operational processes across the customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Salesforce CRM, quoting, order processing, order booking,sales reporting, pipeline management, and cross-functional operational coordination.

This role will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Field Operations, Finance, and Leadership teams to ensure smooth execution from opportunity creation through deployment, invoicing, and customer onboarding.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end sales operations processes including opportunity management, quoting, order processing, order booking, renewals, and contract administration.
  • Support sales teams throughout the sales cycle by ensuring opportunities, quotes, and orders are accurately managed within Salesforce.
  • Ensure data accuracy and compliance across Salesforce opportunities, accounts, quotes, contracts, bookings, and customer records.
  • Create, maintain, and enhance Salesforce reports, dashboards, KPI scorecards, and operational metrics.
  • Analyze sales pipeline performance, bookings, forecast accuracy, conversion rates, and business trends.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on ARR, ACV, TCV, bookings, renewals, sales forecasting, and pipeline management.
  • Coordinate with Field Operations teams to track installation schedules, deployment readiness, device availability, and implementation progress.
  • Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to monitor customer onboarding, deployments, implementation milestones, and operational readiness.
  • Work closely with Sales teams to manage trial requests, trial tracking, trial conversions, commercial approvals, and customer communications.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Accounts teams to resolve invoicing, billing, purchase order, payment, and credit-related issues.
  • Ensure alignment between customer contracts, deployments, installations, bookings, invoices, and Salesforce records.
  • Drive timely resolution of operational issues by coordinating across Sales, Customer Success, Field Operations, Finance, and other stakeholders.
  • Develop business reports, operational reviews, and executive presentations using Microsoft Excel, Power Point, and Microsoft 365 tools.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Thorough understanding of ARR, ACV, TCV, bookings, forecasting, and sales performance metrics.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, data analysis, reconciliation, reporting, and dashboard creation.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Power Point, Share Point, Outlook, Teams, and Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Experience coordinating with Sales, Customer Success, Field Operations, and Finance teams to drive operational execution.

jobDescription:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. Job ROLE: Security Engineer – IAM

Experience : 3- 6 years

About Netradyne

Netradyne is a leader in cutting-edge AI-powered safety and fleet management technology. We strive to enhance driver safety, operational efficiency, and overall user experience. As an innovative and rapidly growing company, we are committed to securing a connected future for the transportation industry through technological advancements.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Security Engineer with a strong focus on Identity and Access Management (IAM) along with Cloud Security. This role offers the opportunity to design, implement, and manage enterprise-level IAM solutions across Microsoft and AWS environments. You will work with cutting-edge IAM technologies including Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), AWS IAM, and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions. We welcome applicants with 3-5 years of IAM experience, and we are open to considering senior-level candidates with broader security expertise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain identity governance frameworks using Microsoft Entra ID, including user provisioning, authentication policies, and conditional access strategies
  • Strong understanding of cloud security concepts including cloud architecture security, shared responsibility models, and cloud-native security best practices
  • Manage AWS IAM policies, roles, and user provisioning across multiple AWS accounts, ensuring least privilege access principles
  • Implement and maintain Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions to monitor, control, and audit privileged user activities
  • Configure and manage multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and federation mechanisms across hybrid environments
  • Conduct security audits and access reviews to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal security policies
  • Integrate IAM solutions with enterprise applications and Saa S platforms
  • Develop and maintain IAM documentation, runbooks, and disaster recovery procedures
  • Manage identity and access controls for AI agents, including Copilot Studio agents and automated workflows
  • Implement security frameworks for Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and agent-to-service authentication
  • Design and implement granular access controls for AI agents, including scope limitations, token management, and service principal governance
  • Design and maintain Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models across enterprise applications, ensuring appropriate permission hierarchies and least privilege principles
  • Build and automate access provisioning and deprovisioning workflows using identity governance tools, reducing manual errors and improving compliance
  • Implement lifecycle management and access certification processes for both human and non-human identities
  • Respond to security incidents related to identity compromise and unauthorized access

Required Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience with IAM technologies and solutions
  • Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, including administration and configuration
  • Solid understanding of AWS IAM including identity federation, cross-account access, and policy management
  • Experience with at least one PAM solution (Delinea Secret Server, Beyond Trust, Cyber Ark, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML, LDAP, Kerberos)
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks (Zero Trust, NIST, SOC 2, ISO 27001)
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of IAM experience or senior-level security background
  • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) or similar certification
  • Experience designing and securing AI agent architectures and autonomous workflows
  • Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and Copilot agents security configurations
  • Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-service authentication patterns
  • Experience designing and implementing RBAC models across complex application ecosystems
  • Expertise in automating access provisioning and deprovisioning workflows using platforms like Okta, Service Now, or Microsoft Identity Manager
  • Experience implementing access controls specifically for AI agents, service principals, and automated workflows
  • Knowledge of identity governance and lifecycle management (ILM) solutions
  • Experience with multiple cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust security architecture
  • Familiarity with scripting languages (Power Shell, Python, Bash) for automation
  • Experience with identity-first security incident response

Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure, Graph API

IAM, AWS SSO, Cognito, AWS Organizations, STS, Cloud Trail

AI & Agents

Okta, Service Now, Microsoft Identity Manager, Automated workflows, Deprovisioning automation, System integration

  • Run Agile / Scrum for software and firmware deliverables, Kanban for recurring activities, and milestone-based tracking for hardware; flex the model to fit each workstream.

  • Demonstrated experience taking products through prototyping and into commercialization / industrialization and mass production.

With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

About Netradyne:

Netradyne provides AI-powered technologies for fleet management and safer roads. An award-winning industry leader in fleet safety and video telematics solutions, Netradyne empowers thousands of commercial fleet customers across North America, Europe, and Asia to enhance their driver performance, reduce risk, and optimize operations.

Netradyne sets the standard among transportation technology companies for enhancing and sustaining road safety, with an industry-leading 25+ billion miles vision-analyzed for risk and an industry-first driver scoring system that reinforces safe behaviours. Founded in 2015, Netradyne is headquartered in San Diego with offices in San Francisco, Nashville, the UK and Bangalore.

For more details visit: www.netradyne.com

About the ROLE:

Netradyne is seeking a highly skilled and experienced dedicated Enterprise IT Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team in Bangalore. This role is critical and serve as the centralised enabler of generative-AI adoption across the enterprise. As a Enterprise IT Automation Engineer, you will turn fragmented, team-by-team AI experimentation into reusable, secure, and scalable capabilities that every function - Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, HR, Admin, Legal, and Finance.

This is a hands-on, build-first role for an engineer who can solution Agentic AI workflows and agents, integrate them into day-to-day operations, and partner with business leaders to ideate, prototype, and scale high-impact use cases. You will operate as a horizontal force-multiplier across the organisation initiatives and embedding responsible AI into how Netradyne works.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES: ​

  • Design, build, and maintain reusable Agentic AI Agents, workflows, MCP connectors, and assistants for business and support functions, prioritising templates that scale beyond a single team.
  • Integrate MCP Connectors with Gen AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Open AI, Claude, Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, into existing Enterprise IT & business systems.
  • Automate business workflows and cross-functional processes, and continuously optimise systems for performance, cost-efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
  • Apply solid software-engineering practices (version control, testing, observability) to AI solutions so they are maintainable, monitored, and production-grade.
  • Partner with function teams to ideate, prototype, and scale AI use cases from concept to production, embedding into their workflows rather than handing off in isolation.
  • Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, Engineering, HR, Admin, Legal, and Finance to identify high-value automation and Gen AI opportunities aligned to organisational goals.
  • Ensure ethical and secure AI deployment in line with Netradyne's Responsible AI principles, data-protection obligations (including GDPR), and Info Sec policies.
  • Support governance of Gen AI tool budgets and purchases org-wide, including visibility into shadow-AI spend and usage-based billing models.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance the performance of deployed automation tools and AI systems, ensuring scalability and reliability in production.
  • Stay current with advances in Gen AI, agentic frameworks, and IT automation, and translate them into actionable recommendations for continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in an IT engineering with at least 5+ years of experience in IT automation, AI tools solution and implementation
  • Hands-on experience designing and shipping Gen AI solutions using tools such as Open AI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Github Co-pilot & Others.
  • Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Java, or similar, with the ability to build and integrate APIs and workflows.
  • Working knowledge of AI / ML frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, and agentic / workflow automation (e.g., n8n, Zapier).
  • Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, and / or Google Workspace).
  • Experience with Microsoft productivity and platform tooling: O365, Share Point, and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI solutions with existing IT systems, with a focus on scalability, security, and reliability.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience deploying Gen AI in a high-speed, AI-driven organisation, with a focus on innovation and scale.
  • Familiarity with IT security frameworks and identity tooling (LDAP, Entra ID, SSO / Id P, VPNs).
  • Exposure to SOC automation, AI-driven ITSM, and / or Info Sec response automation.
  • Understanding of Saa S / Gen AI cost governance, usage-based billing, and license management.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

Why Join Netradyne?

  • Help define and build a brand-new, high-visibility Agentic AI Solutions at the centre of the company's AI strategy.
  • Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real enterprise impact, across every department.
  • Collaborate with talented professionals in a collaborative, inclusive, innovation-driven environment.
  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and strong opportunities for professional growth.

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly.

Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer.

Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact.

Recruitment Fraud Alert!

There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Netradyne employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Netradyne does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set-up and does not use recruitment or job-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ‘@netradyne.com’ or ‘@us-greenhouse-mail.io’.

Please review and apply to our available job openings at Netradyne.com/company/careers. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission's job scams website.

Job Overview:

Netradyne is looking for talented engineers to join our Analytics team comprised of graduates from IITs, IISC, Stanford, UIUC, UCSD etc. As a Staff Research Engineer at Netradyne, you will lead the development of cutting edge AI solutions to enable drivers and fleets realize unsafe driving scenarios in real-time to prevent accidents from happening and reduce fatalities/injuries. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and deploy scalable and reliable AI solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES: ​

You will help design, implement and commercialize driver monitoring and driver assistance algorithms. You will have access to very large datasets and will get to deploy new algorithms/models into thousands of vehicles. As a machine learning research engineer, you may

  • Design and commercialize algorithms characterizing driving behavior.
  • Design, implement and track key metrics; and architect data-driven solutions.
  • Improve machine learning infrastructure for scalable training and inference.
  • Innovate and develop proof of concept solutions showcasing novel capabilities.

Mandatory Skills:​

  • B Tech, M. Tech or Ph D in computer science, electrical engineering or a related area.
  • In-depth understanding of Machine learning (Deep learning & Classic ML) and computer vision concepts
  • Excellent programming skills – Python (required) and C++ (desired).
  • 6.5+ yrs with Research or industry experience within computer vision and machine learning models.
  • Ability to take abstract product concepts and turn them into reality.
  • Ability to innovate on cutting-edge problems without documented solutions.
  • Hands-on experience in handling edge deployments targeting various HW platforms.

Preferred Skills:​

  • Experience with time-series data
  • Experience with Camera calibration, multi-view geometry, 3D reconstruction, SLAM.
  • Experience with road scene understanding (objects, lanes, intersections, signs etc.)
  • Experience with successfully applying machine learning to solve a real-world problem.
  • Experience with conducting successful statistical experiments.
